# Exploratory Analysis
Some Notes:
- We notice that there is both a person_weight and a trip_weight. We could incorporate the weight into the person matching process....
- There are a lot of NAs in employment information

```{r}

persons_processed <- trips_original_raw %>% 
  mutate(id = paste0(small_zone_id,household_seq, person_id)) %>%
  group_by(id) %>% 
  summarise(
    age = first(age), 
    gender = factor(first(gender), levels = c(1,2), labels = c("male","female")), 
    occupation = factor(first(occupation), levels = seq(1,7), labels = c("Full-time employee", "Part-time employee", "Self-employed", "Homemaker", "Student", "Unemployed", "Other")), 
    employment_type = factor(first(employment_type), levels = seq(1,4), labels = c("Full-time","Part-time", "Self-employed","Not-employed")))
  


ggplot(persons_processed) + geom_histogram(aes(age, fill = gender),  position = "dodge")


persons_processed %>% group_by(occupation) %>% count() %>% ggplot() + geom_col(aes(occupation,n))

persons_processed %>% group_by(employment_type) %>% count() %>% ggplot() + geom_col(aes(employment_type,n))


trips_original_raw %>% 

  mutate(id = paste0(small_zone_id,household_seq, person_id)) %>% 
  mutate(unknown_loc = is.na(home_lat) | is.na(home_lon) | is.na(origin_lat) | is.na(origin_lon) | is.na(destination_lat) | is.na(destination_lon)) %>% filter(number_of_trips == 0 | !unknown_loc) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% summarise(age = first(age)) %>% filter(age >95)
```

### Modal split
```{r}
dist_m <- distHaversine(
  cbind(trips_original_raw$origin_lon, trips_original_raw$origin_lat),
  cbind(trips_original_raw$destination_lon, trips_original_raw$destination_lat)
)

trips_processed <- trips_original_raw %>% 
  bind_cols(dist = dist_m) %>% 
  drop_na(dist) %>% 
  mutate(dist_group = case_when(
    dist < 1000 ~ "0 - 1000",
    dist < 2000 ~ "1000 - 2000",
    dist < 5000 ~ "2000 - 5000",
    dist < 10000 ~ "5000 - 10000",
    dist < 20000 ~ "10000 - 20000",
    .default = "20000+"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(mode = factor(main_mode_class_2, levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9), labels = c("pt","pt","car","other","bike","walk","other","other"))) %>% select(mode, dist, dist_group)
```

### Modal Split by Distance class
```{r}


# resources/mode_share_ref.csv
# sum of share column = 1 
trips_processed %>%
  group_by(mode,dist_group) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(), dist = sum(dist, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% filter(!is.na(mode)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% mutate(share_trips = n/sum(n), share_dist = dist/sum(dist)) %>% select(dist_group, main_mode = mode, share = share_trips, share_dist) %>% arrange(dist_group) %>% write_csv("resources/mode_share_ref.csv")

# TRIP BASED MODAL SPLIT, again grouped into mode and dist_group. However, this time the mode shares in each distance group add up to 1.0. This is used for the simwrapper plot row 2 - right. 
# resources/mode_share_per_dist_ref.csv
trips_processed %>%
  group_by(mode,dist_group) %>%
  count() %>% 
  group_by(dist_group) %>% 
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(dist_group) %>% 
  select(dist_group, main_mode = mode, share) %>% 
  write_csv("resources/mode_share_per_dist_ref.csv")
 
# Share of users that use mode at least once a day:
# "resources/mode_users_ref.csv"
pop_size <- trips_original_raw  %>% 
  mutate(id = paste0(small_zone_id,household_seq, person_id)) %>% pull(id) %>% unique() %>% length()

trips_original_raw  %>% 
  mutate(mode = factor(main_mode_class_2, levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9), labels = c("pt","pt","car","other","bike","walk","other","other"))) %>% 
  mutate(id = paste0(small_zone_id,household_seq, person_id)) %>%
  select( id, mode) %>% 
  group_by(id,mode) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  mutate(uses_mode = TRUE) %>% 
  select(-n) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = mode, values_from = uses_mode, values_fill = FALSE) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-id, names_to = "mode",values_to = "uses_mode") %>%
  group_by(mode) %>% 
  summarise(n = sum(uses_mode)) %>% 
  mutate(share = n / pop_size) %>% 
  filter(mode != "NA") %>% 
  select(main_mode = mode, user = share) %>% 
  write_csv("resources/mode_users_ref.csv")


# resources/mode_share_distance_distribution.csv
# takes share only of mobile people
trips_processed %>% 
  mutate(dist_rounded = round(dist,-2)) %>%
  group_by(mode, dist_rounded) %>%
  count() %>% 
  group_by(dist_rounded) %>% 
  mutate(share = n/sum(n)) %>% 
  select(mode, share) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% pivot_wider(names_from = mode,values_from = share, values_fill = 0.0) %>% 
  rename(dist = dist_rounded) %>% arrange(dist) %>%
  filter(dist <=30000) %>% 
  write_csv("resources/mode_share_distance_distribution.csv")
  


```


### Modal Split by Age
```{r}
trips_original_raw %>% 
  bind_cols(dist = dist_m) %>% 
  mutate(ageGr = case_when(
    age >= 85 ~ "85+",
    age >= 75 ~ "75-84",
    age >= 65 ~ "65-74",
    age >= 18 ~ "18-64",
    .default = "0-17"
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(mode3 = factor(main_mode_class_3, levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,9), labels = c("PT","PT","Automobile","Walk / Motorcyle?","Other","Not clear"))) %>% 
  select(ageGr,main_mode_class_3, mode3, dist) %>%
  group_by(ageGr, mode3) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(), dist = sum(dist, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(mode3 %in% c("PT","Automobile","Walk / Motorcyle?")) %>%
  group_by(ageGr) %>%
  mutate(share_trips = n/sum(n), share_dist = dist/sum(dist)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(ageGr,share_trips,fill = mode3)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)


```

# Produce processed files for population generation in MATSim-Gunma-Scenario


Read municipalities, and aggregate to district level, and translate to english
```{r}
district_dict <- data.frame(
  district_jp = c(
    "前橋市", "高崎市", "桐生市", "伊勢崎市", "太田市",
    "沼田市", "館林市", "渋川市", "藤岡市", "富岡市",
    "安中市", "みどり市", "北群馬郡", "多野郡", "甘楽郡",
    "吾妻郡", "利根郡", "佐波郡", "邑楽郡"
  ),
  district_en = c(
    "Maebashi City", "Takasaki City", "Kiryu City", "Isesaki City", "Ota City",
    "Numata City", "Tatebayashi City", "Shibukawa City", "Fujioka City", "Tomioka City",
    "Annaka City", "Midori City", "Kitagunma District", "Tano District", "Kanra District",
    "Agatsuma District", "Tone District", "Sawa District", "Ora District"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

gunma_shp <- st_read("../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/raw/shp/gunma_municip_2020/N03-20200101_10_GML/N03-20_10_200101.shp",options = "ENCODING=CP932")  %>% mutate(district_jp = case_when(is.na(N03_003)~ N03_004, .default = N03_003)) %>% left_join(district_dict) %>% st_transform(2450) 

gunma_shp_landuse <- gunma_shp %>%
  separate_wider_delim(district_en, delim = " ", names = c(NA,"landuse"), cols_remove = FALSE) %>% 
  st_as_sf()  

   
```


Output 1: Persons
idx
region_type
gender
employment
age
```{r}

# trips_raw %>% view()
persons <- trips_raw %>% 
  group_by(id_person) %>% 
  summarise(gender = case_when(first(male) == 1 ~ "m", .default = "f"), 
            age = first(age), 
            mobile_on_day = first(numOfTrips) > 0,
            h_x = first(h_x),
            h_y = first(h_y),
            jobTypeAggr = first(jobTypeAggr)) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("h_x","h_y"), crs=4326) %>% 
  st_transform(2450) %>% 
  st_join(gunma_shp_landuse %>% select(landuse)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  rename(idx = id_person) %>% 
    # the only options are district and city atm
  rename(region_type = landuse) %>% 
  mutate(employment = case_when(jobTypeAggr %in% c("prim sector","seco sector","teri sector") ~ "employed",
                                .default = jobTypeAggr)) %>% 
  select(!jobTypeAggr)

persons %>% 
  write_csv("../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/processed/travel_survey/person_attributes.csv")
  
  
  # tmap_mode("view")
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") + 
  tm_shape(gunma_shp_landuse %>% st_as_sf()) +
    tm_polygons(fill = "landuse")
    # tm_shape(persons %>% st_as_sf()) +
    # tm_dots() 
  
```

Output 2: Activities

All agents in this cleaned dataset start their day at home... 
```{r}
trips_raw %>% group_by(id_person) %>% summarise(h_x = first(h_x), h_y = first(h_y),s_x = first(s_x), s_y = first(s_y), numOfTrips = first(numOfTrips)) %>% 
  mutate(chk = ((h_x == s_x) & (h_y == s_y)) | numOfTrips == 0) %>% 
  filter(!chk)

```

for the output:
p_id
type
duration (in minutes)
leg_duration
leg_dist
leg_mode (leg to activity)

So, LL removed all public transit trips from the processed travel survey...
Also, LL removed all act types except for "home","work","other", NA
```{r}

# what leg_modes do we have?
trips_raw %>% pull(CHOICE_mode) %>% unique()
trips_raw %>% pull(followActi) %>% unique()

# tripurposeAggr has more information (e.g. doesn't aggregate medical into 'other')
home_acts <- trips_raw %>% 
  group_by(p_id =id_person) %>%
  summarise(duration = first(starttime)) %>%
  mutate(act_num = 0, type = "home", leg_dist = -1, leg_duration = -1)

non_home_acts <- trips_raw %>% 
  mutate(leg_dist = round(sqrt((d_x2450 - s_x2450)^2 + (d_y2450-s_y2450)^2))) %>% 
  mutate(dist_to_home = round(sqrt((d_x2450 - h_x2450)^2 + (d_y2450-h_y2450)^2))) %>% 
  select(p_id =id_person, act_num = tripnum, type = followActi, duration = followActiDura, leg_duration = tripduration, leg_mode = CHOICE_mode,leg_dist,dist_to_home) %>% 
  mutate(leg_mode = case_when(leg_mode == "car_driver"~ "car", 
                               leg_mode == "car_passen" ~ "ride",
                               leg_mode == "bicycle" ~ "bike",
                               is.na(leg_mode) ~ "walk",
                                .default = leg_mode))

combined_acts <- bind_rows(non_home_acts,home_acts) %>% arrange(p_id,act_num)
    
write_csv(combined_acts,"../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/processed/travel_survey/activities.csv")
```

```{r}
  district_jp = c(

  ),

    "Maebashi City", "Takasaki City", "Kiryu City", "Isesaki City", "Ota City",

gunma_shp <- st_read("../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/raw/shp/gunma_municip_2020/N03-20200101_10_GML/N03-20_10_200101.shp",options = "ENCODING=CP932")  %>% mutate(district_jp = case_when(is.na(N03_003)~ N03_004, .default = N03_003)) %>% left_join(district_dict) %>% st_transform(2450) %>% separate_wider_delim(district_en, delim = " ", names = c(NA,"landuse"),cols_remove = FALSE) %>% st_as_sf()
```

```{r}
# clean data such that it has coordinates for origin and destination
trips_od_filtered <- trips_raw %>% drop_na(s_x2450,s_y2450,d_x2450,d_y2450)

# origins
origins_data <- trips_od_filtered %>%  st_as_sf(coords = c("s_x2450","s_y2450"), crs = 2450)  %>% st_join(gunma_shp) 
  

# destinations
destinations_data <- trips_od_filtered %>%  st_as_sf(coords = c("d_x2450","d_y2450"), crs = 2450)  %>% st_join(gunma_shp)

# arrange districts by their # of origins:
# od_data %>% group_by(origin) %>% summarise(n = sum(n)) %>% arrange(n) %>% pull(origin) %>% paste0(collapse = "','")
districts_arranged <- c(NA,'Tano District','Tone District','Kanra District','Sawa District','Agatsuma District','Kitagunma District','Numata City','Annaka City','Tomioka City','Fujioka City','Midori City','Shibukawa City','Ora District','Tatebayashi City','Kiryu City','Isesaki City','Ota City','Takasaki City','Maebashi City')


origin_destination_data <-  origins_data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(origin = district_en) %>% bind_cols(destinations_data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(destination = district_en, followActi)) %>% 
  mutate(origin = factor(origin, levels = districts_arranged)) %>% 
  mutate(destination = factor(destination, levels = districts_arranged))




```


OD Matrix for all trips:
```{r}

# prep
od_data <- origin_destination_data %>% group_by(origin,destination) %>% count()

# sankey 
ggplot(
  od_data,
  aes(axis1 = origin, axis2 = destination, y = n)
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = origin), width = 1/12) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "grey80") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Origin", "Destination")) +
  theme_minimal()

# sankey (diff)
ggplot(
  od_data %>% filter(origin != destination),
  aes(axis1 = origin, axis2 = destination, y = n)
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = origin), width = 1/12) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "grey80") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Origin", "Destination")) +
  theme_minimal()


# 2d tiles
ggplot(od_data, aes(x = origin, y = destination, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 6.5, color = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 6.5, color = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Origin",
    y = "Destination",
    fill = "Count"
  )
```

# Commuter Processing Census 2020

```{r}
library(readxl)
commuters <- read_excel("../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/2020census/e06_02-01.xlsx", skip = 7)

commuters_cleaned <- commuters %>% 
  rename(from = "...4") %>% 
  select(!starts_with("...")) %>%
  slice(-(1:2)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -from,names_to = "to",values_to = "n") %>% 
    separate_wider_delim(from, delim = "_", names = c("from",NA)) %>% 
    separate_wider_delim(to, delim = "_", names = c("to",NA)) %>% 
  mutate(n = as.numeric(n)) %>% 
  drop_na(n)
  


# Write OD matrix 
commuters_cleaned %>% write_csv("../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/processed/work_od_matrix.csv")

gunma_shp <- st_read("../public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/jp/gunma/gunma-v1.0/input/shp/gunma_municip_2020/N03-20200101_10_GML/N03-20_10_200101.shp",options = "ENCODING=CP932")  %>% st_transform(2450) %>% rename(zone = N03_007) %>% group_by(zone) %>% summarise()

gunma_shp %>% st_write("../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/processed/zones.shp")




```

```{r}
# trips with origin in each district
gunma_shp %>%
  group_by(N03_007) %>% 
  summarise(district_en = first(district_en)) %>% 
  left_join(commuters_cleaned %>% filter(to == "00000"), by = c("N03_007" = "from")) %>% 
  tm_shape() + tm_polygons(fill = "n") +tm_title("Count of Work Trip Origin in Each Municipality")

# trips with destination in each district 

gunma_shp %>% group_by(N03_007) %>% 
  summarise(district_en = first(district_en)) %>% 
  left_join(commuters_cleaned %>% filter(from == "00000"), by = c("N03_007" = "to")) %>% 
  tm_shape() + tm_polygons(fill = "n") + tm_title("Count of Work Trip Destination in Each Municipality")
```
